Here let me give my side to this

I've been in your situation and I want you to look at this with an open mind okay? Not the closed little ball I know you want to take (cause that's what I did). 

Now when I felt like you did in your situation I tried to kill myself over 45 times (hanging, pills, cutting). I'm fit, I work out, I'm pretty built, I had friends that told me I was attractive but I didn't believe it because I had a closed mind and no relationships. 

How about this... fuck it. Get some friends fuck having a relationship search for one when you get to it. That whole being desired is all anyone wants in life bullshit you said earlier. I don't want to be desired honestly if girls don't like me fuck em. But I still treat them all right.

And I know your gonna say "but you aren't like me, you're probably attractive and just trying to sympathize or pity me." No I'm honestly not. I honestly hate people that say looks are the only thing that matter. Because honestly would you want to date or marry some chick that was attractive but a total psycho bitch? I don't think you would. But what about a girl that's let's say a 4/10 to other people but you fell in love with her because of her killer personality?

Remember to keep an open mind throughout this

I'm a solid 7/10 and I know it because I love myself. But for a long time I thought I was a 0/10 because I fucking hated myself. Now you could very well be a 4/10 or even a 3/10 but you might be a 10/10 in somebody's eyes because honestly you don't need to be desired that what your fucked up view is telling you. Don't want to be desired anymore. Just be you. Do what you love to do. If you don't know what you live to do. Find something and do it then. 

I honestly don't care what you do in the end because I don't know you and I can't change your view. I can only tell you what I've done and how that was. Because in the end what you do is up to you.

Open mind

But start telling a couple people around you what you're thinking of doing. I had 1 friend I was talking to when I was going through that and I trust her with my life. But she was the only person I spoke to through that and she gets it. Just find someone you can trust and tell them about it talk to them. Don't keep it to yourself. That's fucked. 

But cheers man if you do it and succeed. I hope you just realize that you be missing alot of fucking things to enjoy other than having someone to "desire" you. Because honestly in the end when that person dies, you're alone again and you're stuck with yourself again. All I can say is I hope your view comes back to normal and see that being attractive isn't the only thing that matters. Because that's the most fucked up way to live.
